building.name: Laguna Eichler Apartments

historical_record.description: The Laguna Eichler Apartments, designed by the Los Angeles firm Jones & Emmons for the developer Joseph Eichler.

An eighteen-storey tower designed by Jones & Emmons for the developer Joseph Eichler and completed in 1964. Meant as one of four, it was the only one built, and the first apartment tower in the Western Addition A-1 project area.
